findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

gateRows.notes: conclusion=success; build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verify/probe, and ctest suite incl. autooptreproTest all passed

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

gateRows.command: gh workflow run 168745168 --ref master --repo thosoo/avogadro ; gh run watch 42174279224 --repo thosoo/avogadro
gateRows.notes: conclusion=success; build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verify/probe, and ctest suite incl. autooptreproTest all passed

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

gateRows.command: gh workflow run 168745168 --ref master --repo thosoo/avogadro ; gh run watch 42174279224 --repo thosoo/avogadro
gateRows.notes: conclusion=success; build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verify/probe, and ctest suite incl. autooptreproTest all passed

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.

completionRecap.summary: Outcome: The OpenSpec change fix-orbital-status-column is applied to verified completion — the orbital explorer's Status column now renders real progress bars, the table scrolls to HOMO on first fill, and progress updates are bounds-safe. Changed: ProgressBarDelegate::paint sets QStyle::State_Horizontal so Fusion/Qt 6.4 draws a horizontal bar (groove/chunk/label) inside the cell; OrbitalWidget::fillTable retries the HOMO scroll once the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …); OrbitalTableModel mutators ignore out-of-range orbital numbers (1-based) without emitting dataChanged and clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table. Added offscreen orbitalstatustest. Evidence: commit 92134bc45 (pushed to master); local ctest 47/47 green incl. new orbitalstatustest 7/7 (validated red when the D1 flag is reverted); MSVC Windows-installer CI runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 both success. Unresolved: none within scope — opening a PR is a user decision. Next: archive the OpenSpec change (CLI's suggested follow-up) or open a PR against master. — NOTE: supplied completion summary was incomplete; terminalization will use a recorded-facts-only fallback

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

gateRows.notes: conclusion=success; build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verify/probe, and ctest suite incl. autooptreproTest all passed

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

gateRows.notes: conclusion=success; build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verify/probe, and ctest suite incl. autooptreproTest all passed

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

findingGroups.title: MSVC Windows-installer CI (5.2)
findings: Windows installer workflow dispatched on pushed commit 92134bc45 (master); both runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 completed success — build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verification, and the MSVC ctest suite (incl. autooptreproTest under offscreen Qt) all pass, satisfying repo policy for shared UI code before merge.
tests: gh run view 42174279224 --json -> conclusion=success, jobs build-installer (tests)=success + build-installer (installer)=success.

gateRows.command: gh workflow run 168745168 --ref master --repo thosoo/avogadro ; gh run watch 42174279224 --repo thosoo/avogadro
gateRows.notes: conclusion=success; build, Create installer, packaged-runtime verify/probe, and ctest suite incl. autooptreproTest all passed

findingGroups.title: Status-column paint (D1)
findings: Completed orbitals now show filled bars with percentage labels instead of empty boxes — opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal added in ProgressBarDelegate::paint at orbitaltablemodel.h:72 after initFrom(), so Fusion/Qt 6.4 takes the horizontal path.
tests: orbitalstatustest::paintWithinCellAndDrawsLabel renders the delegate into a QImage at a known cell rect; asserts every painted pixel lies inside the cell and >=1 pixel (label) is drawn. Green with fix; fails (outside>0) when the flag is reverted — test proven to bite.

findingGroups.title: First-fill HOMO scroll (D2)
findings: First fill of a populated table now scrolls to the HOMO row like later fills — fillTable retries the scroll after the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …) that re-resolves HOMO through the proxy and guards isValid(); in-call scrollTo kept for later fills.
tests: orbitalstatustest::firstFillLandsOnHOMO fills 120 orbitals (HOMO at source row 50), qWait(100)+processEvents, asserts verticalScrollbar value>0 and the HOMO view cell intersects the viewport.

findingGroups.title: Bounds-safe progress mutators (D3)
findings: Progress mutators ignore an out-of-range orbital number (1-based) with no dataChanged and no crash; clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table — replaces latent OOB heap write / abort-under-asserts (pre-fix w.updateProgress(1000,50) on a 120-row table).
tests: orbitalstatustest::boundsSafeProgressMutators spies dataChanged across all 6 mutators with orbital=1000 on a 5-row model (expect 0 emissions); clearEmptyTableIsNoop spies rowsRemoved+dataChanged on empty clear (expect 0); inRangeUpdateEmitsDataChanged confirms in-range calls still emit exactly one dataChanged each (3 calls -> 3).

findingGroups.title: Regression test harness (D4)
findings: Added offscreen orbitalstatustest executable mirroring the orbitalselectiontest CMake pattern (compiles the surfaces plugin sources, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, registered with ctest) — the paint path previously had zero test coverage.
tests: cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest succeeds; QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest -R orbital 5/5 pass; full ctest 47/47 pass.

completionRecap.objective:
Apply the already-active OpenSpec change "fix-orbital-status-column" to verified completion.

OpenSpec is authoritative for scope, requirements, workflow, artifacts, and task state.
Current schema: spec-driven.
Starting task progress: 0/10.

The GLLA task list is preloaded deterministically from the OpenSpec task list at goal creation.
It is a status mirror, not an independent planning source. Do not call propose_task_list merely to recreate the initial OpenSpec task breakdown.

Initial task mapping:
- GLLA 1 <- OpenSpec 1: [ ] 1.1 In `ProgressBarDelegate::paint` (`libavogadro/src/extensions/surfaces/orbitaltablemodel.h`), add `opt.state |= QStyle::State_Horizontal;` after `opt.initFrom(...)` and verify the existing suites still pass: `cmake --build build --target orbitalselectiontest && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest --test-dir build -R orbitalSelection --output-on-failure`
- GLLA 2 <- OpenSpec 2: [ ] 2.1 Add 1-based bounds guard to `setOrbitalProgressRange`, `incrementStage`, `setOrbitalProgressValue`, `finishProgress`, `resetProgress`, `setProgressToZero` in `orbitaltablemodel.cpp` (early return, no `dataChanged` when `orbital < 1 || orbital > m_orbitals.size()`) and make `clearOrbitals()` return early on an empty list; verify by compiling the surfaces plugin and running `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest --test-dir build -R orbital --output-on-failure`
- GLLA 3 <- OpenSpec 3: [ ] 3.1 In `OrbitalWidget::fillTable` (`orbitalwidget.cpp`), defer the HOMO scroll with `QTimer::singleShot(0, ui.table, …)` that re-resolves the HOMO row through `m_sortedTableModel`, re-validates it, and calls `scrollTo(PositionAtCenter)`; keep the existing in-call scroll; verify later fills still land on HOMO and the first fill now does (test in 4.x)
- GLLA 4 <- OpenSpec 4: [ ] 4.1 Add `orbitalstatustest` executable to `libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt` following the `orbitalselectiontest` pattern (compiles surfaces plugin sources, `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`, registered with ctest) and verify it builds: `cmake --build build --target orbitalstatustest`
- GLLA 5 <- OpenSpec 5: [ ] 4.2 Implement the delegate-paint test (design D4 assertions 1–2): render the status delegate at a known cell rect into a `QImage`, assert all non-background pixels lie inside the cell rect and at least one non-background pixel (label) lies inside; run and confirm green with the fix and red when the flag line from 1.1 is reverted (validates the test bites)
- GLLA 6 <- OpenSpec 6: [ ] 4.3 Implement model-bounds tests (design D4 assertions 3–4): spy `dataChanged` while applying each progress mutator with an out-of-range orbital (verify no emission, process survives) and call `clearOrbitals()` on an empty model (verify no removal notification); also verify in-range updates still emit exactly one `dataChanged`
- GLLA 7 <- OpenSpec 7: [ ] 4.4 Implement first-fill HOMO test (design D4 assertion 5): fresh widget, `fillTable` with 120 orbitals, process events, assert the HOMO view row is inside the viewport (scrollbar value > 0 and HOMO row visible)
- GLLA 8 <- OpenSpec 8: [ ] 4.5 Run the full new suite plus neighboring suites: `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ctest --test-dir build -R "orbital|surface" --output-on-failure` and confirm all green
- GLLA 9 <- OpenSpec 9: [ ] 5.1 Self-review the diff against design D1–D4 (flag placement, guard semantics, timer context object anchoring to `ui.table`) and remove the throwaway probe artifacts if any were staged
- GLLA 10 <- OpenSpec 10: [ ] 5.2 Trigger the Windows installer workflow (`gh workflow run 168745168 --ref <branch> --repo thosoo/avogadro`) and verify the build and test suite pass on MSVC per repo policy before opening a PR

Use the installed OpenSpec apply workflow/skill as the implementation procedure.

At the start of work, after every context compaction, after every resume, and whenever task state is uncertain:

1. Run:
   openspec status --change "fix-orbital-status-column" --json

2. Run:
   openspec instructions apply --change "fix-orbital-status-column" --json

3. Treat the returned OpenSpec state, instruction, tasks, context, operationGuidance, and contextFiles as authoritative.

4. Read all contextFiles relevant to the remaining work before modifying code.

Resume from the first genuinely incomplete task. Do not redo completed work unnecessarily.

Implement every remaining required task.

GLLA task-list synchronization is a hard, per-task requirement, using GLLA's own task tools (not prose):

- GLLA task id N mirrors exactly one OpenSpec task; its title prefix "[OpenSpec <task-id>]" names that OpenSpec task.
- When you START a mirrored OpenSpec task, call update_task_status with that GLLA id and status "in_progress".
- In the SAME turn where you legitimately flip an OpenSpec checkbox to "- [x]" (or otherwise complete that OpenSpec task), call complete_task with the corresponding GLLA id. One OpenSpec checkbox flip = one complete_task call. Never batch all syncs to the end of the session.
- When several mirrored tasks genuinely finish in one turn, one update_task_batch call is also acceptable.
- GLLA's pending-task gate REFUSES complete_goal while any mirrored GLLA task is still open — a stale mirror blocks goal completion even when OpenSpec itself is finished.
- Never mark either side complete merely because work was attempted.
- The bridge extension also mirrors OpenSpec completions into the GLLA list at turn boundaries as a safety net, but do not rely on it; keep the mirror correct yourself.

If the authoritative OpenSpec task set itself changes after attachment, do not silently ignore the difference or invent an independent plan. Reconcile against a fresh OpenSpec apply response before completion.

Run relevant builds, focused tests, integration tests, and regression checks as work progresses. Fix failures caused by this change rather than bypassing them.

Do not weaken, delete, rewrite, reinterpret, or silently defer OpenSpec requirements merely to make implementation easier.

Do not switch to a different OpenSpec change.

If OpenSpec reports state="blocked", resolve the missing required planning artifact through the OpenSpec workflow before continuing implementation. Do not invent missing requirements merely to get past the block.

If OpenSpec reports state="all_done", do not immediately declare success. Perform the final verification below first.

Before claiming completion, independently re-read:

- the current OpenSpec status;
- the current OpenSpec apply instructions;
- all relevant OpenSpec artifacts;
- the repository diff and working-tree state;
- the actual build/test/regression outputs.
completionRecap.summary: Outcome: The OpenSpec change fix-orbital-status-column is applied to verified completion — the orbital explorer's Status column now renders real progress bars, the table scrolls to HOMO on first fill, and progress updates are bounds-safe. Changed: ProgressBarDelegate::paint sets QStyle::State_Horizontal so Fusion/Qt 6.4 draws a horizontal bar (groove/chunk/label) inside the cell; OrbitalWidget::fillTable retries the HOMO scroll once the first-fill pending-layout settles via a ui.table-anchored QTimer::singleShot(0, …); OrbitalTableModel mutators ignore out-of-range orbital numbers (1-based) without emitting dataChanged and clearOrbitals() is a safe no-op on an empty table. Added offscreen orbitalstatustest. Evidence: commit 92134bc45 (pushed to master); local ctest 47/47 green incl. new orbitalstatustest 7/7 (validated red when the D1 flag is reverted); MSVC Windows-installer CI runs #42174279224 and #42174262543 both success. Unresolved: none within scope — opening a PR is a user decision. Next: archive the OpenSpec change (CLI's suggested follow-up) or open a PR against master. — NOTE: supplied completion summary was incomplete; terminalization will use a recorded-facts-only fallback

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1.1] Create erasetool.h/cpp skeleton (AVOGADRO_TOOL metadata, eraser icon, tooltip, no shortcut, usefulness below Draw, settings widget with Adjust Hydrogens checkbox default checked) and verify the tools plugin builds
[OpenSpec 1.2] Implement mousePressEvent: record press point in device pixels, begin lasso gesture (clear path, set dragging), lazily connect toolActivated (Qt::UniqueConnection), accept the event
[OpenSpec 1.3] Implement mouseMoveEvent: while dragging, append the pointer position (device pixels) to the lasso path; accept

[OpenSpec 1.4] Implement mouseReleaseEvent release assembly: minimum-path guard (abort on tap), tryLockForWrite (abort cleanly on contention), construct one DeleteAtomDrawCommand per victim inside an UndoSequence (text "Lasso Delete") and return it

[OpenSpec 2.1] Implement screen-space containment in device pixels: project atoms via camera()->project(), bbox-cull, even-odd point-in-polygon, auto-close unclosed path; add pure static pointInPolygon helper

[OpenSpec 3.1] Managed-hydrogen parity: with adjust-hydrogens enabled exclude hydrogens from the victim set and pass adjustHydrogens=true to DeleteAtomDrawCommand; with it disabled every enclosed atom is a victim
[OpenSpec 4.1] Implement toolActivated(Tool*) and null-molecule/changed-document abandon: clear lasso path and dragging flag (no command, no mutation); next gesture starts clean

[OpenSpec 4.2] Implement paint(GLWidget*): while dragging with a non-empty path, unproject device-pixel points to world space and draw a closed line loop via painter()->drawLineLoop so it renders on all tiers without painter diagnostics
tasks.verificationContract: overlay renders on real window tier / no diagnostic spam

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 5.1] Add erasetool entry to libavogadro/src/tools/CMakeLists.txt, create erasetool.qrc referencing an eraser icon (erase.png), verify the tool builds and appears in the palette
[OpenSpec 6.1] Add erasetooltest to libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (compiles erasetool.cpp + drawcommand.cpp directly, offscreen QPA, registered with ctest) and verify it builds

[OpenSpec 6.2] Implement containment-deletion test: molecule + GLWidget with known camera, lasso around a methyl group (and unclosed loop), assert enclosed atoms/bonds deleted while outside atoms survive
[OpenSpec 6.3] Implement tap no-op test: press-and-release without significant travel deletes nothing and adds no undo entry
[OpenSpec 6.4] Implement single-undo-step test: one undo restores the whole lasso (atoms + bonds), one redo re-deletes
[OpenSpec 6.5] Implement managed-hydrogen parity test: with adjust-hydrogens on, looping a carbon deletes it and churns its managed hydrogens; with it off, hydrogens deleted as victims
[OpenSpec 6.6] Implement interrupted-lasso cleanup test: tool switch mid-lasso (via toolActivated) leaves no residue and the next gesture starts clean
[OpenSpec 6.7] Run the new suite plus neighboring suites and confirm all green

[OpenSpec 7.1] Self-review the diff against design D1-D9 (containment space, guard semantics, undo grouping, hydrogen parity, lock discipline, overlay, gesture scoping, MSVC portability) and remove throwaway artifacts
[OpenSpec 7.2] Trigger the Windows installer workflow and verify the build and test suite pass on MSVC per repo policy before opening a PR

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1.1] Create erasetool.h/cpp skeleton (AVOGADRO_TOOL metadata, eraser icon, tooltip, no shortcut, usefulness below Draw, settings widget with Adjust Hydrogens checkbox default checked) and verify the tools plugin builds
[OpenSpec 1.2] Implement mousePressEvent: record press point in device pixels, begin lasso gesture (clear path, set dragging), lazily connect toolActivated (Qt::UniqueConnection), accept the event
[OpenSpec 1.3] Implement mouseMoveEvent: while dragging, append the pointer position (device pixels) to the lasso path; accept

[OpenSpec 1.4] Implement mouseReleaseEvent release assembly: minimum-path guard (abort on tap), tryLockForWrite (abort cleanly on contention), construct one DeleteAtomDrawCommand per victim inside an UndoSequence (text "Lasso Delete") and return it

[OpenSpec 2.1] Implement screen-space containment in device pixels: project atoms via camera()->project(), bbox-cull, even-odd point-in-polygon, auto-close unclosed path; add pure static pointInPolygon helper

[OpenSpec 3.1] Managed-hydrogen parity: with adjust-hydrogens enabled exclude hydrogens from the victim set and pass adjustHydrogens=true to DeleteAtomDrawCommand; with it disabled every enclosed atom is a victim
[OpenSpec 4.1] Implement toolActivated(Tool*) and null-molecule/changed-document abandon: clear lasso path and dragging flag (no command, no mutation); next gesture starts clean

[OpenSpec 4.2] Implement paint(GLWidget*): while dragging with a non-empty path, unproject device-pixel points to world space and draw a closed line loop via painter()->drawLineLoop so it renders on all tiers without painter diagnostics
tasks.verificationContract: overlay renders on real window tier / no diagnostic spam

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 5.1] Add erasetool entry to libavogadro/src/tools/CMakeLists.txt, create erasetool.qrc referencing an eraser icon (erase.png), verify the tool builds and appears in the palette
[OpenSpec 6.1] Add erasetooltest to libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (compiles erasetool.cpp + drawcommand.cpp directly, offscreen QPA, registered with ctest) and verify it builds

[OpenSpec 6.2] Implement containment-deletion test: molecule + GLWidget with known camera, lasso around a methyl group (and unclosed loop), assert enclosed atoms/bonds deleted while outside atoms survive
[OpenSpec 6.3] Implement tap no-op test: press-and-release without significant travel deletes nothing and adds no undo entry
[OpenSpec 6.4] Implement single-undo-step test: one undo restores the whole lasso (atoms + bonds), one redo re-deletes
[OpenSpec 6.5] Implement managed-hydrogen parity test: with adjust-hydrogens on, looping a carbon deletes it and churns its managed hydrogens; with it off, hydrogens deleted as victims
[OpenSpec 6.6] Implement interrupted-lasso cleanup test: tool switch mid-lasso (via toolActivated) leaves no residue and the next gesture starts clean
[OpenSpec 6.7] Run the new suite plus neighboring suites and confirm all green

[OpenSpec 7.1] Self-review the diff against design D1-D9 (containment space, guard semantics, undo grouping, hydrogen parity, lock discipline, overlay, gesture scoping, MSVC portability) and remove throwaway artifacts
[OpenSpec 7.2] Trigger the Windows installer workflow and verify the build and test suite pass on MSVC per repo policy before opening a PR

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1.1] Create erasetool.h/cpp skeleton (AVOGADRO_TOOL metadata, eraser icon, tooltip, no shortcut, usefulness below Draw, settings widget with Adjust Hydrogens checkbox default checked) and verify the tools plugin builds

[OpenSpec 2.1] Implement screen-space containment in device pixels: project atoms via camera()->project(), bbox-cull, even-odd point-in-polygon, auto-close unclosed path; add pure static pointInPolygon helper

[OpenSpec 3.1] Managed-hydrogen parity: with adjust-hydrogens enabled exclude hydrogens from the victim set and pass adjustHydrogens=true to DeleteAtomDrawCommand; with it disabled every enclosed atom is a victim
[OpenSpec 4.1] Implement toolActivated(Tool*) and null-molecule/changed-document abandon: clear lasso path and dragging flag (no command, no mutation); next gesture starts clean

[OpenSpec 4.2] Implement paint(GLWidget*): while dragging with a non-empty path, unproject device-pixel points to world space and draw a closed line loop via painter()->drawLineLoop so it renders on all tiers without painter diagnostics
tasks.verificationContract: overlay renders on real window tier / no diagnostic spam

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 5.1] Add erasetool entry to libavogadro/src/tools/CMakeLists.txt, create erasetool.qrc referencing an eraser icon (erase.png), verify the tool builds and appears in the palette
[OpenSpec 6.1] Add erasetooltest to libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (compiles erasetool.cpp + drawcommand.cpp directly, offscreen QPA, registered with ctest) and verify it builds

[OpenSpec 6.2] Implement containment-deletion test: molecule + GLWidget with known camera, lasso around a methyl group (and unclosed loop), assert enclosed atoms/bonds deleted while outside atoms survive
[OpenSpec 6.3] Implement tap no-op test: press-and-release without significant travel deletes nothing and adds no undo entry
[OpenSpec 6.4] Implement single-undo-step test: one undo restores the whole lasso (atoms + bonds), one redo re-deletes
[OpenSpec 6.5] Implement managed-hydrogen parity test: with adjust-hydrogens on, looping a carbon deletes it and churns its managed hydrogens; with it off, hydrogens deleted as victims
[OpenSpec 6.6] Implement interrupted-lasso cleanup test: tool switch mid-lasso (via toolActivated) leaves no residue and the next gesture starts clean
[OpenSpec 6.7] Run the new suite plus neighboring suites and confirm all green

[OpenSpec 7.1] Self-review the diff against design D1-D9 (containment space, guard semantics, undo grouping, hydrogen parity, lock discipline, overlay, gesture scoping, MSVC portability) and remove throwaway artifacts

[OpenSpec 4.1] Implement toolActivated(Tool*) and null-molecule/changed-document abandon: clear lasso path and dragging flag (no command, no mutation); next gesture starts clean

[OpenSpec 4.2] Implement paint(GLWidget*): while dragging with a non-empty path, unproject device-pixel points to world space and draw a closed line loop via painter()->drawLineLoop so it renders on all tiers without painter diagnostics

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1.1] Create erasetool.h/cpp skeleton (AVOGADRO_TOOL metadata, eraser icon, tooltip, no shortcut, usefulness below Draw, settings widget with Adjust Hydrogens checkbox default checked) and verify the tools plugin builds
[OpenSpec 1.2] Implement mousePressEvent: record press point in device pixels, begin lasso gesture (clear path, set dragging), lazily connect toolActivated (Qt::UniqueConnection), accept the event
[OpenSpec 1.3] Implement mouseMoveEvent: while dragging, append the pointer position (device pixels) to the lasso path; accept

[OpenSpec 1.4] Implement mouseReleaseEvent release assembly: minimum-path guard (abort on tap), tryLockForWrite (abort cleanly on contention), construct one DeleteAtomDrawCommand per victim inside an UndoSequence (text "Lasso Delete") and return it

[OpenSpec 2.1] Implement screen-space containment in device pixels: project atoms via camera()->project(), bbox-cull, even-odd point-in-polygon, auto-close unclosed path; add pure static pointInPolygon helper

[OpenSpec 4.1] Implement toolActivated(Tool*) and null-molecule/changed-document abandon: clear lasso path and dragging flag (no command, no mutation); next gesture starts clean

[OpenSpec 4.2] Implement paint(GLWidget*): while dragging with a non-empty path, unproject device-pixel points to world space and draw a closed line loop via painter()->drawLineLoop so it renders on all tiers without painter diagnostics

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1.1] Create erasetool.h/cpp skeleton (AVOGADRO_TOOL metadata, eraser icon, tooltip, no shortcut, usefulness below Draw, settings widget with Adjust Hydrogens checkbox default checked) and verify the tools plugin builds
[OpenSpec 1.2] Implement mousePressEvent: record press point in device pixels, begin lasso gesture (clear path, set dragging), lazily connect toolActivated (Qt::UniqueConnection), accept the event
[OpenSpec 1.3] Implement mouseMoveEvent: while dragging, append the pointer position (device pixels) to the lasso path; accept

[OpenSpec 1.4] Implement mouseReleaseEvent release assembly: minimum-path guard (abort on tap), tryLockForWrite (abort cleanly on contention), construct one DeleteAtomDrawCommand per victim inside an UndoSequence (text "Lasso Delete") and return it

[OpenSpec 2.1] Implement screen-space containment in device pixels: project atoms via camera()->project(), bbox-cull, even-odd point-in-polygon, auto-close unclosed path; add pure static pointInPolygon helper

[OpenSpec 3.1] Managed-hydrogen parity: with adjust-hydrogens enabled exclude hydrogens from the victim set and pass adjustHydrogens=true to DeleteAtomDrawCommand; with it disabled every enclosed atom is a victim
[OpenSpec 4.1] Implement toolActivated(Tool*) and null-molecule/changed-document abandon: clear lasso path and dragging flag (no command, no mutation); next gesture starts clean

[OpenSpec 4.2] Implement paint(GLWidget*): while dragging with a non-empty path, unproject device-pixel points to world space and draw a closed line loop via painter()->drawLineLoop so it renders on all tiers without painter diagnostics
tasks.verificationContract: overlay renders on real window tier / no diagnostic spam

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 5.1] Add erasetool entry to libavogadro/src/tools/CMakeLists.txt, create erasetool.qrc referencing an eraser icon (erase.png), verify the tool builds and appears in the palette
[OpenSpec 6.1] Add erasetooltest to libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (compiles erasetool.cpp + drawcommand.cpp directly, offscreen QPA, registered with ctest) and verify it builds

[OpenSpec 6.2] Implement containment-deletion test: molecule + GLWidget with known camera, lasso around a methyl group (and unclosed loop), assert enclosed atoms/bonds deleted while outside atoms survive
[OpenSpec 6.3] Implement tap no-op test: press-and-release without significant travel deletes nothing and adds no undo entry
[OpenSpec 6.4] Implement single-undo-step test: one undo restores the whole lasso (atoms + bonds), one redo re-deletes
[OpenSpec 6.5] Implement managed-hydrogen parity test: with adjust-hydrogens on, looping a carbon deletes it and churns its managed hydrogens; with it off, hydrogens deleted as victims
[OpenSpec 6.6] Implement interrupted-lasso cleanup test: tool switch mid-lasso (via toolActivated) leaves no residue and the next gesture starts clean
[OpenSpec 6.7] Run the new suite plus neighboring suites and confirm all green

[OpenSpec 7.1] Self-review the diff against design D1-D9 (containment space, guard semantics, undo grouping, hydrogen parity, lock discipline, overlay, gesture scoping, MSVC portability) and remove throwaway artifacts
[OpenSpec 7.2] Trigger the Windows installer workflow and verify the build and test suite pass on MSVC per repo policy before opening a PR

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 1.1] Create erasetool.h/cpp skeleton (AVOGADRO_TOOL metadata, eraser icon, tooltip, no shortcut, usefulness below Draw, settings widget with Adjust Hydrogens checkbox default checked) and verify the tools plugin builds
[OpenSpec 1.2] Implement mousePressEvent: record press point in device pixels, begin lasso gesture (clear path, set dragging), lazily connect toolActivated (Qt::UniqueConnection), accept the event
[OpenSpec 1.3] Implement mouseMoveEvent: while dragging, append the pointer position (device pixels) to the lasso path; accept

[OpenSpec 1.4] Implement mouseReleaseEvent release assembly: minimum-path guard (abort on tap), tryLockForWrite (abort cleanly on contention), construct one DeleteAtomDrawCommand per victim inside an UndoSequence (text "Lasso Delete") and return it

[OpenSpec 2.1] Implement screen-space containment in device pixels: project atoms via camera()->project(), bbox-cull, even-odd point-in-polygon, auto-close unclosed path; add pure static pointInPolygon helper

[OpenSpec 3.1] Managed-hydrogen parity: with adjust-hydrogens enabled exclude hydrogens from the victim set and pass adjustHydrogens=true to DeleteAtomDrawCommand; with it disabled every enclosed atom is a victim
[OpenSpec 4.1] Implement toolActivated(Tool*) and null-molecule/changed-document abandon: clear lasso path and dragging flag (no command, no mutation); next gesture starts clean

[OpenSpec 4.2] Implement paint(GLWidget*): while dragging with a non-empty path, unproject device-pixel points to world space and draw a closed line loop via painter()->drawLineLoop so it renders on all tiers without painter diagnostics
tasks.verificationContract: overlay renders on real window tier / no diagnostic spam

tasks.title: [OpenSpec 5.1] Add erasetool entry to libavogadro/src/tools/CMakeLists.txt, create erasetool.qrc referencing an eraser icon (erase.png), verify the tool builds and appears in the palette
[OpenSpec 6.1] Add erasetooltest to libavogadro/tests/CMakeLists.txt (compiles erasetool.cpp + drawcommand.cpp directly, offscreen QPA, registered with ctest) and verify it builds

[OpenSpec 6.2] Implement containment-deletion test: molecule + GLWidget with known camera, lasso around a methyl group (and unclosed loop), assert enclosed atoms/bonds deleted while outside atoms survive
[OpenSpec 6.3] Implement tap no-op test: press-and-release without significant travel deletes nothing and adds no undo entry
[OpenSpec 6.4] Implement single-undo-step test: one undo restores the whole lasso (atoms + bonds), one redo re-deletes
[OpenSpec 6.5] Implement managed-hydrogen parity test: with adjust-hydrogens on, looping a carbon deletes it and churns its managed hydrogens; with it off, hydrogens deleted as victims
[OpenSpec 6.6] Implement interrupted-lasso cleanup test: tool switch mid-lasso (via toolActivated) leaves no residue and the next gesture starts clean
[OpenSpec 6.7] Run the new suite plus neighboring suites and confirm all green

[OpenSpec 7.1] Self-review the diff against design D1-D9 (containment space, guard semantics, undo grouping, hydrogen parity, lock discipline, overlay, gesture scoping, MSVC portability) and remove throwaway artifacts
[OpenSpec 7.2] Trigger the Windows installer workflow and verify the build and test suite pass on MSVC per repo policy before opening a PR
